stories.title: Veja como foi o fim de semana dos candidatos a presidente

en.title: See how the weekend was for presidential candidates
en.summary: Presidential candidates campaigned across São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina, addressing topics including healthcare, prison reform, organized crime, workers' rights, entrepreneurship, and sports betting restrictions.

stories.title: Cheia de rio alaga bairros e arrasta geladeira para fora de imóvel em Itapetininga; vídeo

en.title: River flooding submerges neighborhoods and sweeps refrigerator from property in Itapetininga; video
en.summary: Heavy rains caused a river in Itapetininga to rise approximately eight meters above normal levels, flooding 107 homes and affecting 59 others with water in their yards on Saturday.

stories.title: Região de Piracicaba começa a semana com 1,8 mil vagas de emprego; veja como concorrer

en.title: Piracicaba region begins week with 1.8 thousand job openings; see how to apply
en.summary: Five cities in the Piracicaba region are offering 1,852 job vacancies starting Monday across industries including manufacturing, commerce, and services, with positions available through municipal worker support services.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja como foi o 36º dia de campanha dos candidatos ao governo do Amapá

en.title: 2026 Elections: see how the 36th day of campaign for candidates to Amapá government was
en.summary: Candidates for Amapá governor completed their 36th official campaign day on Sunday, with activities including meetings and electoral program recordings. The first round is scheduled for October 4, 2026.

stories.title: Morre Paulo Roberto Teixeira, médico sanitarista que atuou na construção das políticas de combate ao HIV e à Aids no Brasil

en.title: Paulo Roberto Teixeira, sanitarian doctor who worked on HIV and AIDS prevention policies in Brazil, dies
en.summary: Paulo Roberto Teixeira, a sanitarian physician who played a significant role in developing Brazil's HIV and AIDS response policies, died at age 77. His work strengthened the public health system and expanded access to antiretroviral medications for thousands of people.

stories.title: Partido de Putin lidera eleições parlamentares na Rússia, aponta pesquisa boca de urna

en.title: Putin's party leads Russian parliamentary elections, exit poll shows
en.summary: Exit polls indicate that the governing party United Russia, led by Vladimir Putin, is leading parliamentary elections with 57.5% of votes after 14% of ballots were counted.

stories.title: Parte de palco cede e derruba bailarinos em show de Gloria Groove em MG; veja vídeo

en.title: Stage partially collapses and drops dancers during Gloria Groove show in MG; see video
en.summary: A portion of the stage collapsed during a Gloria Groove performance at a festival in Viçosa, Minas Gerais, causing dancers to fall. According to the singer's representative, no one was injured.

stories.title: Palco onde Gloria Groove se apresentava cede, e dois bailarinos caem em buraco; assista

en.title: Stage where Gloria Groove was performing collapses, and two dancers fall into hole; watch
en.summary: A section of the stage at the Spring Festival Unity in Viçosa, Minas Gerais, collapsed during Gloria Groove's performance on Saturday night, causing two backup dancers to fall into the resulting gap.

stories.title: Cheia do rio Tietê arrasta lixo para parque e prédio de usina histórica em Salto (SP); veja vídeo

en.title: Tietê River Flooding Drags Garbage to Park and Historic Power Plant Building in Salto (SP); See Video
en.summary: Heavy flooding of the Tietê River on days 13 and 14 left large amounts of waste and debris accumulated in Lavras Park in Salto, São Paulo state, including the former Lavras Hydroelectric Plant.

stories.title: Thiago Lacerda e Vanessa Lóes se separam após 25 anos: ‘Além do luto há uma jornada linda’

en.title: Thiago Lacerda and Vanessa Lóes Separate After 25 Years: 'Beyond the Mourning There Is a Beautiful Journey'
en.summary: Actors Thiago Lacerda and Vanessa Lóes have announced their separation after 25 years together. The couple has three children.

stories.title: Morre Paulo Roberto Teixeira, médico pioneiro no enfrentamento ao HIV e à Aids no Brasil

en.title: Paulo Roberto Teixeira Dies, Pioneer Doctor in Fighting HIV and AIDS in Brazil
en.summary: Public health physician Paulo Roberto Teixeira, a pioneer in developing public health policies against HIV and AIDS in Brazil, died at age 77. The cause of death was not disclosed.

stories.title: ‘Desastre’, diz Merz após boca de urna apontar liderança da extrema direita nas eleições regionais

en.title: 'Disaster,' Says Merz After Exit Polls Point to Far-Right Leadership in Regional Elections
en.summary: Merz characterized exit polls indicating far-right party leadership in regional elections as a disaster.

stories.title: Esquerda vence eleição em Berlim, mas extrema direita avança no leste da Alemanha

en.title: Left wins election in Berlin, but far-right advances in eastern Germany
en.summary: The Left Party won state elections in Berlin, but the far-right made significant gains in eastern Germany, a result described by Chancellor Friedrich Merz as a disaster.

stories.title: França tomará medidas após Irã fechar seu centro cultural em Teerã

en.title: France will take measures after Iran closes its cultural center in Tehran
en.summary: Iran sealed a French language center linked to the French embassy in Tehran, prompting France to summon the Iranian ambassador and respond with measures to this action deemed unjustifiable.

stories.title: Escritório da esposa de Moraes nega vínculo pessoal com Vorcaro em viagem de jatinho

en.title: Office of Moraes's wife denies personal link with Vorcaro in private jet trip
en.summary: The law office of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes's wife denied personal relationships in private jet contracting arrangements for staff, following publication of video showing the couple disembarking at Rio airport.

stories.title: Dona da Bluesoft e da VR Software planeja investir R$ 1 bi para tecnologia de supermercados

en.title: Owner of Bluesoft and VR Software plans to invest R$ 1 billion in supermarket technology
en.summary: Quantum, the holding company that acquired Bluesoft and VR Software, plans to invest over R$ 1 billion in the next 12 months on new acquisitions and artificial intelligence tools for the supermarket sector.

stories.title: Governo Trump prepara sanções contra o Tribunal Penal Internacional, informa WSJ

en.title: Trump Government Prepares Sanctions Against International Criminal Court, WSJ Reports
en.summary: The Trump administration is preparing to impose sanctions on the International Criminal Court that would restrict most transactions with the institution after a grace period of six to seven months, according to Wall Street Journal reporting.
